feeds.title: KetoDiet Blog
feeds.description: I'm Martina, an x10 cookbook author, top rated keto diet app creator, recipe developer, food photographer, writer, and a firm believer in low-carb living.Here at KetoDiet App, we share easy low-carb, keto and gluten-free recipes as well as expert articles to help you make informed choices.

feeds.title: The Low Carb Diabetic
feeds.description: Promoting a low carb higher fat lifestyle for the safe control of weight and diabetes. The authors are all diabetics and believe in the low carb lifestyle, and minimal or no medication for the good control of diabetes.

feeds.title: Sugar Free Londoner
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Katrin! Sugar Free Londoner is a blog dedicated to delicious family food without added sugar. You'll find these pages packed with easy and tasty gluten free and low carb recipes all tested in my London kitchen as well as interesting facts and information around sugar, healthy eating and well-being.

feeds.title: Romy London » Vegan Keto & Low Carb Recipes
feeds.description: This section of Romy London is for people who wish to create a healthy lifestyle by following a plant-based keto diet. I'm Romy. I've been running Romylondonuk since 2015 after finding my love for plant-based cooking when I switched to a vegan lifestyle.

feeds.title: LowCarbAlpha
feeds.description: Selection of keto, low carb, paleo, diet and nutrition articles to help you reach your health and weight loss goals. We're committed to supporting your journey to better health and wellness!

feeds.title: Carbophobic Blog
feeds.description: Low-Carb Recipes, Tips, Motivation. low-carb principles to maintain your weight and stay healthy. Provide information about right multivitamin for a low carb diet, and how low carb diets work.

feeds.title: Fats of Life
feeds.description: Covers exciting and interesting Keto and low carb recipes with macros - by chef and recipe developer Monya Kilian Palmer. My name is Monya (my friends call me Monnie) and I started blogging as a hobby after my husband and I switched to the keto lifestyle in early 2018.

feeds.title: Keto Fitness Club Blog
feeds.description: Simple UK low carb & keto recipes, information, cookbooks and more. From low carb breads to family friendly keto dinners, we've got something for everyone. We are committed to building a community rooted in positivity and support, celebrating the highs and embracing the lows.

feeds.title: Low Carb in the UK Blog
feeds.description: Discover hints, tips and advice about eating Low Carb in the UK along with recipes! I help women ditch belly fat and gain more energy in less than ten weeks without fussing about what they eat or starving themselves.
